blogTitle: HOW 2 TELL IF UR LAYOUT WAS STOLEN (a tutorial) (its not about anyone) (its about kittyxcore)
about: hi im liz and i made ur layout. no seriously, if ur page has a div overlay w/ the tables hidden and a little scrolling friends box, i either made it or someone ripped it. i've been coding since i was 12 on my dads computer in notepad and i have NEVER used a premade from those popup sites. div overlays or nothing. tables r for ppl who have given up. i'll pimp ur profile for free if u credit me and for $5 if u dont (kidding) (not kidding). ps to the person who copied my hello kitty div layout and changed the pink 2 a slightly different pink: i can SEE the comments in the code. u left my name in it.
meet: Who I'd like to meet: whoever invented the div overlay so i can thank them, whoever invented the popup layout sites so i can NOT thank them, and tom so he can fix the profile editor (jk i dont use it. i have hands.)

bulletins.subject: PSA: HOW 2 CREDIT A LAYOUT (its one line. one.)
bulletins.body: hi. this is not about anyone. this is about EVERYONE. if u use a layout somebody MADE (not one from a popup site, an actual person, w/ hands), u put 'layout by ___' at the bottom. thats it. one line. i even leave the credit line IN the code so u dont have 2 type it. u just have 2 not DELETE it. changing the pink does not make it urs. changing the font 2 comic sans does not make it urs (it makes it worse). i'm not naming anyone. her name starts w/ k and ends w/ ittyxcore. anyway i love u all, credit me, ttyl
